pecas.prompt: A friendly cartoon dairy cow with a white body covered in several large irregular black patches on her side and back, a black patch around one eye, a soft pink muzzle, two small curved horns, a pink udder and a tail with a black tuft, smiling gently. Soft matte clay 3D illustration, children's storybook style, rich saturated colours, soft shadows. The whole cow is inside the frame from nose to tail, centred, seen straight from the side, standing on all four legs, filling about three quarters of the image width. Soft even studio light coming from the upper left, gentle contact shadow directly under the object. The animal floats alone on a plain, perfectly flat, bright magenta background (#FF00FF), with clear empty margin on all four sides. Every surface is smooth, blank and unmarked. The image contains only the object itself. Modelled in soft matte clay, like a children's storybook toy.
